summary: On a managed tenant, access sent by the managing tenant is now clearly marked and protected from change.

new.title: Central access marked read-only
new.text: On a managed tenant, everything from the managing tenant is marked CENTRAL and read-only on the Access map and Review current delegations. Central admins can still get local access.

fixes.title: AD placements in one place
fixes.text: The admin account OUs moved to Settings > Hybrid AD & workloads, next to the OU for new AD groups.

fixes.title: Smaller fixes
fixes.text: The environment name examples are now generic.
